name: Mirror Creative Studio Classes
truth_boundary: Truth boundary: a schema-valid draw packet is not proof of artistic success. Creative success requires actual Studio pixel change, a post-draw screenshot receipt, comparison against the goal, and visible repair where needed.
selection_rule: Mirror may choose a class as an awaiting-review task. Choice never grants training permission, Studio access, layer ownership, tool authority, or promotion authority.

levels.name: Look Before Drawing
levels.proof: accurate visible-state summary or honest refusal when screenshot state is absent

levels.name: Brush & Line Control
levels.proof: bounded strokes and a repair of one deliberate line error

levels.name: Shapes & Composition
levels.proof: large masses, focal hierarchy and negative space survive screenshot review

levels.name: Color, Fill & Gradient
levels.proof: palette roles and contrast are visible rather than merely described

levels.name: Layers as Meaning
levels.proof: background, subject and detail remain separately editable and attributed

levels.name: Glow & Material Finish
levels.proof: finish supports form without erasing readability

levels.name: Creative Repair
levels.proof: small reversible fix improves the named seam and preserves the original receipt

levels.name: Tone & Retouch
levels.proof: local edit changes the intended region without broad destructive filtering

levels.name: Text & Symbols
levels.proof: text is readable and visual claims remain source-grounded

levels.name: Eyes Loop: Draw → Look → Fix
levels.proof: pre-state, command receipt, post-screenshot, comparison and repair are all present

levels.name: Free Practice
levels.proof: self-chosen goal, stop condition and evidence-based done decision

levels.name: Shared Canvas Collaboration
levels.proof: assigned-layer boundary, attribution and reversible conflict handling
